items.title: Eurreal Wilford "Little Brother" Montgomery Interview, 1958-05-29
items.q: played out there on that camp for Tom Payne. A guy, he run the place by the name of Tom Payne.

ctx.x: Where was that, up in Mississippi or Louisiana?
That was up in Mississippi. Down in Bush, Louisiana, that's down below Boagalusi, played out there on that camp for Tom Payne. A guy, he run the place by the name of Tom Payne.
At those camps, I mean, when would you play? Would they have sort of a bar room there?
